title: Dreamer’s allies seek revenge on the Dudleys
summary: The Dudleys turn their attacks on Tommy Dreamer and his allies into a personal war. Their on-screen injury to Beulah gives Dreamer a powerful reason to pursue revenge.

chapters.title: Dreamer and Sandman beat the Dudleys
chapters.result: Dreamer and Sandman win the tag match.
chapters.context: The rivalry continues beyond the result, drawing more allies into the conflict.

chapters.title: The six-man street fight
chapters.result: Dreamer, Sandman and Spike defeat the Dudleys.
chapters.context: Dreamer’s team gets revenge after Beulah’s storyline neck injury; that angle is not presented as a real medical event.
